about: Descriptions for the 47 places on mapsma.com that had none (live site, 20 Nov 2026). Our words, from each place's listing source and web search, 60-140 characters like the site's own. apply=true: ready (high or medium confidence); apply=false: could not be confirmed online (drafted from the name and kind only): check on the spot or leave empty. 'check' lists doubts found (hours that differ, possible closure or new name). desc_es: the same in Mexican Spanish (the site shows desc only today). Put desc into data/*.json and run scripts/rebuild.py (the site's own tools).

places.name: La Hija del Manantial
places.desc: Sister bar of El Manantial with regular live music: ginger margaritas and mezcalitas, tuna carpaccio and shrimp tostadas.
places.desc_es: Bar hermano de El Manantial con música en vivo frecuente: margaritas de jengibre, mezcalitas, carpaccio de atún y tostadas de camarón.
facts: Sister bar to El Manantial, near the Jardín
Live music (Fri and Sat nights; some say most days)
Ginger margaritas, mezcalitas, tuna carpaccio, chipotle shrimp tostada, tinga, tempura fish and chips

places.name: La Azotea
places.desc: Rooftop bar above Pueblo Viejo with sunset views, cocktails and bar bites; try the shrimp tacos in a jicama shell.
places.desc_es: Bar en la azotea arriba de Pueblo Viejo, con vista al atardecer, cócteles y botanas; prueba los tacos de camarón en tortilla de jícama.
facts: Rooftop at Umarán 6, no sign: enter through Pueblo Viejo and go up the stairs
Sunset views; misters on hot days
Bar bites: jicama-shell tacos with tempura shrimp, guacamole, cauliflower, pizzas; cocktails and evening drink specials

places.name: Selina
places.desc: Rooftop bar-restaurant at the Selina hotel with city and sunset views: chile-spiked cocktails, octopus tacos, aguachile and barbacoa sopes.
places.desc_es: Bar-restaurante en la azotea del hotel Selina, con vista al atardecer: cocteles con chile, tacos de pulpo, aguachile y sopes de barbacoa.
places.check: Selina chain was sold and rebranded as Socialtel in 2024–25; the San Miguel property is still listed as Selina, and Food and Pleasure calls the rooftop 'Anónimo'. Check the current name.
facts: The Rooftop at Selina, Cuna de Allende 11, up three flights of stairs
City and sunset views
International menu with Mexican touches: octopus and chicharrón tacos, aguachile, barbacoa sopes, burgers, pasta
Chile-spiked cocktails (El Financiero, 2022)
Shows big football games

places.name: Luna Rooftop
places.desc: Rosewood hotel's rooftop bar and restaurant, open to all: sunset views, cocktails and Mediterranean tapas with Mexican ingredients.
places.desc_es: Bar y restaurante en la azotea del hotel Rosewood, abierto a todos: atardeceres, cócteles y tapas mediterráneas con ingredientes mexicanos.
facts: Rooftop of the Rosewood hotel, open to non-guests
Sunset views over the city
Mediterranean menu with local Mexican ingredients; tapas, croquettes, shrimp crudo, pizza, tacos
Cocktails; pricey; book for sunset
sources: WebSearch: Luna Rooftop Rosewood San Miguel de Allende menu (rosewoodhotels.com snippets)

places.name: Cava Sautto
places.desc: Wine and spirits shop with a good range of Mexican labels and regular tastings; also artisan cheeses and preserves to take home.
places.desc_es: Tienda de vinos y destilados con buenas etiquetas mexicanas y catas frecuentes; también quesos de artesano y conservas para llevar.
places.check: Website reported offline and no 2025–26 source found; may have closed or moved (Forbes México mentioned a planned store in the historic centre). Confirm before publishing.
facts: Wine and spirits shop at Codo 36; first San Miguel store opened December 2018
Well-known premium Mexican labels; tastings and cocktail workshops
Also sourdough from local bakers, artisan cheeses, preserves
